This article is a stub. ALGE-Timing is an Austrian sports timing manufacturer, based in Lustenau,
whose [SWIM 2000](../equipment/swimming/timers/alge-swim-2000.md) and
[Timy](../equipment/swimming/timers/alge-timy.md) consoles are among the
[timers](../equipment/swimming/timers/index.md) [Hy-Tek Meet Manager](../software/hy-tek-meet-manager.md) supports, the first over a serial
cable and the second through a shared results file.

It also sells a semi-automatic package for eight lanes plus the start channel, in cabled
and radio versions; see the
[semi-automatic timing overview](../equipment/swimming/semi-automatic/index.md) for that
class of equipment and the [vendors](index.md) register for the companies this wiki covers.

Its swim timing console is the [TM-SWIM](../equipment/swimming/timers/alge-tm-swim.md),
which sounds the start tone over the lane speakers at a frequency and length set in
[SwimTime](../software/swimtime.md).
